device.name: Franka TMR spine and battery ROS 2 interfaces

facts.text: The position topic republishes the last successful position on read failure with valid=false; the state topic copies success into valid and includes error_code and error_description.
Cancellation waits for the blocking motion worker, then re-arms the drive before returning the cancelled motion result.
BatteryState voltage, current, charge, capacity and design_capacity are set to NaN by the source node.
SpineActionServer constructs the ROS 2 node with the base name franka_spine_node.
The spine node registers the private MoveAbsolute action '~/move_absolute' with a ReentrantCallbackGroup.
The spine node registers private services '~/get_state', '~/get_position', '~/switch_off', '~/halt' and '~/get_parameters_spine'.
The spine node publishes SpinePosition on '~/position' and SpineState on '~/state' at 1/feedback_rate, and only while each topic has a subscriber.
The spine action server fills MoveAbsolute.Result.success from the motion result and copies stop_by and error from the same result.
SpineController.move_absolute requires the drive to be SwitchedOn before it starts motion and returns an error otherwise.
SpineController.switch_off posts the REST switch-off call, invalidates the cached state and reports success only when the REST call succeeded.
The spine REST client's switch_off method posts 'spine:switch-off'.
SpineController.halt posts the DS402 quick-stop, waits for SwitchedOff and then re-arms with switch-on, so a successful Halt returns the drive to SwitchedOn rather than leaving it disabled.
The spine REST client has no motion:halt route; halt_motion posts 'motion:quick-stop', which enters QuickStopActive and then SwitchedOff.
Halt.srv describes the halt service as immediately halting ongoing motion and ending in SwitchedOn.
SwitchOff.srv describes the switch-off service as transitioning to SwitchedOff and disabling motion.
The spine node registers the private SwitchOn service '~/switch_on' with the ReentrantCallbackGroup.
The switch-on callback calls SpineController.switch_on and copies its success, state and message into the SwitchOn response.
SpineController.switch_on posts the REST switch-on call, invalidates the cached state and reports success only when the REST call succeeded.
The spine REST client's switch_on method posts 'spine:switch-on'.
SwitchOn.srv describes the switch-on service as transitioning to SwitchedOn and enabling motion.
MoveAbsolute.action declares position in metres and velocity, acceleration and deceleration as float64 values with a strictly positive requirement.
MOTION_READ_TIMEOUT is 600.0 seconds: a hang guard for the blocking motion-mm:start POST, not a device motion limit; the device holds the POST until the move finishes or is quick-stopped.
UserLimitsData stores lower_limit and upper_limit with 0.0 dataclass defaults.
SpineController.get_parameters reads the device parameters response and returns its lower_limit and upper_limit values.
BatteryServer constructs the ROS 2 node with the base name franka_battery_node.
BatteryServer registers std_srvs/Trigger services '~/stop_wireless_charging' and '~/try_start_wireless_charging'; their callbacks copy the controller result's success and message.
BatteryServer publishes sensor_msgs/BatteryState on '~/battery_state' when enable_battery_topic is true and publish_rate is positive.
BatteryServer converts battery_level_rsoc to BatteryState.percentage by dividing by 100 and copies batt_pos_terminal to temperature; charging flags select the power-supply status and location.
BatteryController.stop_wireless_charging and try_start_wireless_charging call the battery REST API and return success with a message.
The battery API client exposes 'wireless-charging:stop' and 'wireless-charging:try-start' POST routes.

safe_state.description: The spine drive is switched off through the acknowledged /franka_spine_node/switch_off service, which transitions it to SwitchedOff and disables motion; the separate halt service is not the safe state because it re-arms the drive to SwitchedOn.
